newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks off on profit-taking, jitters.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks off on profit-taking, jitters.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed off on profit-taking in a market still jittery on rumors circulated Thursday over a possible cabinet shake-up, traders said.
"There were no foreign investors around. The market's still nervous from yesterday," said one broker.
The bolsa's 19-share index closed off 1.11 percent at 5,956.77 points on trade of 13 million shares worth four billion bolivars ($8.5 million).
In a brief telephone interview with Reuters, Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff reiterated that no cabinet changes were planned or expected.
Among traded-issues, 22 fell, 10 rose and nine closed flat.

Market leader Electricidad de Caracas lost 9.60 bolivars to end at 528.50, foods producer Mavesa slipped 1.00 bolivar to finish at 150.00 and steel producer Sivensa closed off 3.00 bolivars at 361.00.
